cipher.name: Rot5AlphabetRot5DigitCipher
cipher.idea: A highly reliable, simple substitution cipher that shifts all alphabetic characters forward by 5 positions (wrapping around A-Z and a-z) and shifts all digits forward by 5 positions (wrapping around 0-9). All other characters, such as spaces and punctuation, remain completely unchanged. This ensures perfect reversibility and high reasoning capability for the model while altering token structures.

1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it forward by 5 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary: encrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 65 + 5) % 26) + 65).
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it forward by 5 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary: encrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 97 + 5) % 26) + 97).
3. If it is a digit (0-9), shift it forward by 5 positions, wrapping around if necessary: encrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 48 + 5) % 10) + 48).
4. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, etc.), leave it completely unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:

1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it backward by 5 positions in the alphabet, wrapping around if necessary: decrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 65 - 5) % 26) + 65).

3. If it is a digit (0-9), shift it backward by 5 positions, wrapping around if necessary: decrypt(char) = chr(((ord(char) - 48 - 5) % 10) + 48).
